title: 3×3 Eyes — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
The feeling that 3×3 Eyes means something is a chemical event with an evolutionary address. 3×3 Eyes is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yuzo Takada. It was serialized in Kodansha's Seinen manga magazines Young Magazine Kaizokuban and Weekly Young Magazine from 1987 to 2002, spanning to a total of 40 volumes.

What culture calls destiny in 3×3 Eyes is usually just selection pressure wearing a suit. Various video games came out based on the 3×3 Eyes manga and OVA. The first titled, 3×3 Eyes Seima kōrin-den (3×3EYES 聖魔降臨伝) was developed by Yutaka and released on July 28, 1992.
